legal.intro: Ask about Thai laws and local rules in Phuket. Answers come only from our sources, with citations.
legal.placeholder: e.g. Can a jet ski shop keep my passport?
legal.tooLong: Please keep your question under {max} characters.

transport.label: Taxis
transport.q: The taxi driver will not use the meter. Is that allowed?

rental.label: Rentals
rental.q: Can a scooter rental shop keep my passport as a deposit?

alcohol_drugs.q: Is cannabis legal for tourists in Phuket?

report.title: Report Assistant
report.intro: Tell us what happened. We help you write a short summary in Thai (with an English copy) to show the police.

notice.title: Before you start
notice.aiProvider: What you type is sent to an AI service to write the summary.
notice.notStored: Nothing is stored unless you choose to save it at the end.
notice.noPassport: Do not type your passport number, phone number or other ID numbers.
notice.notFiling: This tool does not file a police report. You bring the summary to the police yourself.

chat.title: Interview
chat.greeting: Hello. I will ask you a few questions about what happened, then write a summary for the police. In your own words, what happened?
chat.label: Your message
chat.stopped: Stopped. Send a message or try again.
chat.readyHint: All set. You can now create the summary.
chat.notReadyHint: Answer the questions. When the assistant has read back your facts and you confirm, you can create the summary.
chat.confirmStartOver: Start over? This conversation will be cleared.

limits.message_too_long: Please keep each message under {max} characters.
limits.too_many: This conversation has reached its length limit. Please start over and keep answers short.
limits.too_long: This conversation has reached its length limit. Please start over and keep answers short.

summary.title: Your summary
summary.notPolice: This is NOT a police report.
summary.notPoliceText: Nothing has been sent to the police. Bring this summary (printed or on your phone) to the Tourist Police or a police station. Help:
summary.checkHint: Check the English copy. If something is wrong, go back to the chat and correct it.

save.title: Save for 30 days (optional)
save.text: Save this summary so you can open it again on this device. It is deleted automatically after 30 days, or earlier if you delete it.
save.consent: I agree that SabaiSafe stores this summary for up to 30 days so I can open it again. I can delete it at any time.
save.saved: Saved. Available on this device until {date}.
save.noStorage: Saved, but this browser cannot remember it. Keep the PDF instead.
save.confirmDelete: Delete the saved summary now? This cannot be undone.
save.existing: You have a saved summary on this device (until {date}).
save.replaces: You already have a saved summary on this device. Saving this one deletes the earlier one first, because only one can be kept.
